name: Stage 33: Lövsjöns sydspets to Brytsebo
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 33, Lövsjöns sydspets to Brytsebo.
utilities: Parking exists at Lövsjöns sydspets and at Brytsebo/Skvättan; Länsstyrelsen lists about 7 spaces at the reserve entrance. Transit is most practical via Kolmårdens djurpark plus connector 32:2, or sparse school-day line 902 near Marielundsvägen for the Brytsebo side; check Östgötatrafiken live before relying on it.

No shop, tap, power, or endpoint toilet was verified directly on stage 33. Nearby services are seasonal/conditional at Kolmården/Vildmarkshotellet and Kvarsebo via connector 33:1; do not treat zoo/hotel/cafe facilities as guaranteed public trail services.
waterSources: Ålkärrsdrogen is the only confirmed named trail water source on stage 33. Sörmlandsleden calls it good spring water, and OSM maps the same spring, but the association's general water guidance says sources are not quality-tested or guaranteed; treat/filter and carry backup.
Do not use Bråviken as drinking water; it is a Baltic inlet. Lövsjön/lake water and the Skyttholmens brygga shelter area are not verified drinking-water refill points.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official stage is 8 km in Norrköpings kommun/Östergötland. Naturkartan's embedded/API geometry measures about 7.7 km and is stored reversed from Brytsebo to Lövsjön, while OSM relation 3690246 is a clean single component around 8.0 km; use 8 km as the catalog/planning distance.

The first 700 m are gravel road, then mixed forest; the final Bråviken section is one of Sörmlandsleden's most demanding with steep descent/ascent, viewpoints, bathing, old pine forest, and a signed shortcut around the steepest section.

Official Sörmlandsleden pages showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Bråvikenbranten had no authority-posted reserve news item at check time, but that is not a guarantee of trail condition; fire risk/fire-ban status is time-sensitive and must be checked same day.

In Bråvikenbranten reserve: tenting is allowed max two consecutive nights in the same place, dogs/pets must be leashed, fires only at Länsstyrelsen-signposted grill places, no damaging living/dead trees or rock/ground, no collecting mosses/lichens/non-edible fungi, and climbing requires permit.

The Bråviken/Skyttholmens brygga shelter cluster is reached by an approximately 600 m side trip near the end. It is first-come/shared and has shelter, fireplace/grill, benches, picnic/rest function, firewood context, dry toilet, and no verified potable water; Bråviken is brackish inlet water.

Keep core stage 33 distinct from connector 33:1: Rövargrottan, Högudden, blue side paths to bathing cliffs/jättegrytor and the Kvarsebo/Säter ferry are mainly 33:1 or side-route material, not the direct Lövsjön-to-Brytsebo stage.
Östgötaleden relation 6124617 overlaps all OSM Stage 33 way members. Treat Östgötaleden as a named overlay/label stack, not duplicate physical route geometry.

Connector 33:1 links Brytsebo with Kvarsebo/Säter ferry and Östgötaleden. Older official text mentions bus 432, but current checks point to line 902 on school days only; always verify live timetable and ferry status.

facilities.name: Lövsjöns sydspets stage start
facilities.description: Official start and small parking/access point. Also the junction with connector 32:2 from Kolmårdens djurpark; map sources vary by roughly 50-130 m around the south-tip road/parking node.

facilities.name: Ålkärrsdrogen source
facilities.description: Official cold spring about 3 km from Lövsjön; described as good water, but not quality-tested or guaranteed. OSM maps the same spring but not as a serviced drinking-water tap. Treat/filter and carry backup.

facilities.name: Bråvikenbranten reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve rules near the Bråviken section: dogs leashed, tent max two nights in same place, fires only at signed grill places, no damaging trees/dead wood/rock/ground, no collecting mosses/lichens/non-edible fungi, climbing needs Länsstyrelsen permit. Check current fire risk.

facilities.name: Bråviken steep section / shortcut
facilities.description: Official text calls the Bråviken end one of Sörmlandsleden's most demanding parts; a signed shortcut bypasses the steep descent/ascent and bathing/viewpoint loop. User reports describe this as more climbing/scrambling than ordinary hiking in places.

facilities.name: Skyttholmens brygga / Bråviken shelter
facilities.description: Shelter on an approximately 600 m spur near Bråviken. Sources report about 4 sleeping places, benches, picnic/rest function, fireplace/grill, dry toilet and firewood context. No verified potable water; Bråviken water is brackish.

facilities.name: Skyttholmens brygga fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace/grill at the shelter spur. Use only if current fire rules allow; Bråvikenbranten permits fires only at signed grill places.

facilities.name: Skyttholmens brygga dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet mapped near the Bråviken shelter cluster; no drinking water, handwashing or paper guarantee. No toilet verified at the stage endpoints.

facilities.name: Skyttholmen lower beach/rest spot
facilities.description: Small Bråviken beach/rest spot below the shelter with mapped fire/rest context. Treat as informal bathing/rest, not a municipal sampled bathing place or drinking-water source.

facilities.name: Bråviken bathing/rest area
facilities.description: Official stage text highlights Bråviken bathing/rest and viewpoints near the steep option; this is sea/inlet water, not a drinking-water refill, and no exact municipal bathing-water sample point was verified.

facilities.name: Rövargrottan side-trip caveat
facilities.description: Cave/side-route context near Stage 33:1/Skvättan, not the core Stage 33 line. Enter at own risk, bring a light, and avoid solo/inexperienced cave visits.

facilities.name: Kopparbogrottan safety caveat
facilities.description: Bråvikenbranten cave context west of the main Stage 33 line. Länsstyrelsen warns of deep cracks, narrow passages and water and does not recommend it for inexperienced visitors; never go alone.

facilities.name: Östgötaleden overlap warning
facilities.description: OSM Östgötaleden relation 6124617 overlaps Stage 33's OSM ways. Show as an overlapping named route, not duplicate geometry or an extra connector.

facilities.name: Skvättan/Bråvikenbranten parking
facilities.description: Reserve parking near Brytsebo/Bråvikenbranten, about 7 spaces with information boards and picnic table. Do not assume roadside overflow parking.

facilities.name: Brytsebo stage end
facilities.description: Official shared end of stage 33/start of stage 34. Use this as the main route-node coordinate; nearby parking is at Brytsebo/Skvättan, but exact parking pins vary by source.

facilities.name: Marielundsvägen bus access
facilities.description: Closest researched bus access for the Brytsebo/Skvättan side. Länsstyrelsen describes school-day Krokek-Kvarsebo service with about 600 m walk; current line 902 timetable is school-day Monday-Friday only in the checked 2025-12-14 to 2026-06-14 PDF. Do not use stale bus 432 references.

facilities.name: Kolmårdens djurpark connector access
facilities.description: Main practical public-transport approach to Lövsjön via blue-marked connector 32:2, about 1.5 km from Kolmårdens djurpark to the stage 33 start.

facilities.name: Kvarsebo/Säter ferry connector context
facilities.description: Connector 33:1 starts at Kvarsebo/Säter ferry and links to Brytsebo/Östgötaleden. Check Trafikverket Skenäsleden status and current bus service; older bus 432 references are likely stale.

facilities.name: Vildmarkshotellet/Kolmården services
facilities.description: Nearby lodging/restaurant/service context for the Kolmården access side, but opening/admission and seasonal access vary. Not directly on stage 33.

facilities.name: Qvarsebo seasonal cafe context
facilities.description: Kvarsebo village/ferry-side seasonal cafe/shop context for connector 33:1 access. More than 2 km from stage 33; verify opening hours.
